text: If you are considering upgrading your notification settings, you might want to hold off for a week or two. Most platforms roll out major updates in phases, and the first few days often come with unexpected bugs or battery drain issues. Delaying your upgrade allows the community to iron out the kinks and ensures you aren't the one troubleshooting a broken feature. Wait for the patch notes to settle before making the switch.
